# ZTools

> ZTools brings useful digital tools into one place, including JSON formatting, password generation, image compression, QR codes, and PDF work. Many tasks run in your browser. AI and some other tools send input to a server or provider. Some actions require sign-in and have plan limits.


## Get ZTools

- [All apps](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/apps): every released surface of ZTools.
- [ZTools web app](https://ztools.zaions.com)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zaions.ztools)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ztools-text-utility-tools/olkionpeobbpgmlfigafppbkniomelle)

## Developers

- [ZTools for developers](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/developers): what a key, an assistant or a webhook can reach, and the limits on each plan.
- [Access keys](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/developers/access-keys): keys look like zt_pat_…; Never expiry is only for read-only keys.
- [The API](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/developers/api): base URL https://luzmtjynzrxwqwzlswjq.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/v1, Authorization: Bearer header, cursor pages, errors.
- [OpenAPI document](https://luzmtjynzrxwqwzlswjq.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/v1/openapi.json): public, no key needed.
- [Assistants](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/developers/assistants): MCP server https://luzmtjynzrxwqwzlswjq.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Cursor; a removal waits for the person's yes.
- [Webhooks](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/developers/webhooks): Standard Webhooks signing (webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature v1 HMAC-SHA256), every event and its payload.
- [Two-step sign-in](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/developers/two-step-sign-in): authenticator app, ten recovery codes, opt-in 7-day remembered browser.
- Never reachable from outside: Speak recordings, AI assistant conversations, payments, sign-in, and other people's private rows. There is no calendar feed.

## Key URLs

- App: https://ztools.zaions.com
- Documentation: https://ztools-docs.zaions.com
- GitHub (docs): https://github.com/aoneahsan/ztools-docs
- Author: https://aoneahsan.com

## Highlights

- Tools across Text, PDF, Image, Data, Generator, Encoding, Conversion, SEO, Math, Health, Education, Finance, Productivity, Media, Design, Developer, Extractor, Legal, Utility, and Growth categories
- Processing depends on the tool: many tasks run in your browser; some send files or input to a server or provider. Read the app privacy policy before submitting sensitive input.
- Machine-readable tool registry with each tool's real URL: https://ztools.zaions.com/tools-registry.json
- Many tools can be used without signing in. Growth Suite requires an account and has plan limits.
- Documentation source on GitHub
- Android app on Google Play; no iOS app

## Documentation structure

- `/docs/intro` — overview
- `/docs/getting-started` — usage walkthrough
- `/docs/tools` — full tool catalog (organized by category)
- `/docs/guides` — long-form how-to tutorials
- `/docs/developers` — the API, MCP server for assistants, webhooks and two-step sign-in
- `/blog` — release notes and dev journal

## Analytics & privacy

The docs site may use configured analytics and error-reporting services. See the [documentation privacy page](https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/privacy) for details about those services.

Many ZTools tasks run in your browser. AI and some other tools send input to a server or provider; handling varies by action. See the [ZTools privacy policy](https://ztools.zaions.com/privacy-policy).
